blocks.title: Free vibrations (azad jhoolna)
blocks.text: Jab koi jism kisi bahar ki force (external force) ki mudakhlat (dakhal) ke baghair apni natural frequency (qudrati frequency) par jhoole to kehte hain ke woh free vibrations kar raha hai.
Misal: Fig. 14.12 ka simple pendulum, jab use mean position se thora sa hata kar chhora jaye, apni natural frequency par azadi se jhoolta hai; yeh frequency sirf us ki lambai par munhasir hai.

blocks.alt: Sahare par O se latakta simple pendulum. Bob A, darmiyani jagah B aur C par dikhaya gaya hai; A aur C ke darmiyan nuqtedar qaus aur teer jo B se guzarte hue dono taraf jhoolna dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.12: Simple pendulum ki free oscillation (kitab ki Figure 14.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Free oscillations mein jism ki kul energy constant rehti hai, yani energy bachi rehti hai (conserved). Hum farz karte hain ke koi rukawat wali force (resistance, jaise hawa ki ragar) nahi, is liye amplitude bhi constant rehta hai.
Agar azadi se jhoolte system par bahar se force lagayi jaye to forced vibrations hoti hain. Misal: jab jhoole ko baar baar dhakka diya jaye to forced vibrations paida hoti hain (Fig. 14.13).

blocks.alt: Jhoole ke do lamhe. Har aik mein aik aadmi jhoole ke peeche khara us par bethi larki ko dhakka deta hai; doosre mein jhoola aage ja chuka hai aur woh baazu phaila kar ab bhi dhakka de raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.13: Jhoole ki forced oscillations ki misal (kitab ki Figure 14.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Bhari machinery chalne se factory ke farsh ka thartharana forced vibration ki misal hai. Ek aur misal: taar wale saazon (string instruments) ke lakri ke boards (sound boards) bajne par unchi awaz paida karte hain; taar ki thartharahat board ko zabardasti thartharati hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Guitar ki taar, bajti ghanti (bell), atoms ka jhoolna, pul (bridge) ka thartharana aur imarat (building) ka hilna: kitab inhen free oscillations ki misalein batati hai.

blocks.prompt: Jhoole par baithe bachche ko ek dafa dhakka de kar chhor diya jaye to yeh free oscillation hai ya forced? Aur agar har chakkar par dhakka diya jaye?
blocks.explanation: Ek dafa dhakka de kar chhorna: free oscillation (jhoola apni natural frequency par jhoolta hai aur ragar se aahista aahista ruk jata hai). Har chakkar par dhakka dena: forced oscillation.

items: Free oscillation: natural frequency par, bahar ki force ke baghair; ragar na ho to energy aur amplitude constant.
Forced oscillation: bahar ki periodic force se, jaise jhoole ko baar baar dhakka ya machinery se farsh ka thartharana.
